title: Windowed capture runner omits provisioned X11 runtime libraries
body: Direct launches through tools/run-vixen-windowed-captures.sh did not inherit CTest's LD_LIBRARY_PATH; the starfield branch's windowed captures failed on this host while pickinst passed. I had to derive the provisioned X11/Vulkan library directories from build/wsl/CMakeCache.txt and append them to the runner environment. Suggested consolidation: have the runner resolve runtime dependencies from the configured build before launching the app.

title: Default VIXEN preset omits input-axis fail-scenario test
body: The vixen-wsl preset leaves VIXEN_FAIL_SCENARIOS=OFF, so test_input_axes is not built or registered in the default CTest suite. I had to reconfigure with -DVIXEN_FAIL_SCENARIOS=ON to cover the merged per-frame axes feature. Suggested consolidation: expose lightweight feature tests in the default witness suite or provide a standard feature-test preset that includes them without enabling destructive fault sweeps.

title: Headless capture CTest cases omit provisioned runtime libraries
body: The capture CTest selection with DISPLAY and Vulkan variables unset failed in HeadlessStarfieldGraph.CaptureFirst/CaptureSecond with VK_ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE_DRIVER when LD_LIBRARY_PATH was unset. Supplying the provisioned Mesa/Vulkan/X11 library directories through LD_LIBRARY_PATH made the same 11-case selection pass 11/11; the native capture tests already set this path, but the headless app tests do not. Suggested consolidation: apply the configured runtime dependency path to all Vulkan app CTest cases through one CMake helper.

title: Share complete VulkanDevice setup across GPU test fixtures
body: To exercise the production VoxelSelectionProviderNode from test_shadow_correctness.cpp, I had to copy queue, graphicsQueueIndex, gpuMemoryProperties, and queueFamilyProperties initialization from test_body_instance_raymarch_render.cpp; setting only VkDevice left the provider readback without a queue. Suggested a shared Vulkan test fixture/factory that returns a fully initialized VulkanDevice shell.
